items.title: Carolyn Buck Interview, 1969-03-25
items.q: Now the rosary beads I had given to Cheryl.

ctx.x: No, George himself got the Jimmy Newman one. Well, that's the one that he enjoys playing.

Yeah, that's the one that he was playing with. Mm-hmm. And, well, that's in the back room with his small case, and he has a double case for the two clarinets. Dorothy is taking the double case, just the case, because she got that for him. She bought it for him, and she'd like to have that. And the clarinet that Bill Russell purchased for and gave to George, and he was sending it to a Japanese boy, to... ...Woyichi Kawai. Because George always said that if anything ever happened, he would like one of his clarinets…
Did George ever talk about integration and color children?
